findings.title: createPatch requirements not merged into the main json-patch spec
findings.why: The archived add-create-patch change adds requirements for createPatch (round trip, minimal output, array item operations). The main spec ends at 'Errors are identifiable' with no mention of createPatch (grep finds none). The archive step did not sync the spec, so the project's current spec does not describe the exported createPatch API. The json-merge-patch change was synced correctly.
